editorial.description_en: A hill far enough away that the air between has taken its colour and given back blue.
editorial.description_ja: 遠くの山のような、空気をふくんだ青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.790, C 0.050, h 244.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 遠 (tō, distant) + 山 (yama, hill or mountain). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Distant Hill" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 遠山. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — ame-zora at ΔE00 4.3, samu-zora at ΔE00 4.5, oki-gasumi at ΔE00 4.6. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (64°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
